Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes Rail tooltips inherit right-side placement while retaining explicit overrides and the existing narrow-screen fallback. **Example:** Hover Pages in the desktop sidebar rail. - **Before:** The hint opens above the icon and covers neighboring rail controls. - **After:** The hint opens beside the icon, vertically centered. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Direct visual proof supports the production change, but the introduced viewport-dependent assertions fail WebKit CI. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected before/after screenshots exercise Pages hover in the browser-rendered Control UI with synthetic Gateway data and visibly show the corrected placement; the reported browser run additionally covers wrapped and title-adapted rail controls. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Rail hints overlap neighboring controls because their top placement clamps against the window edge. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction has clear visual value and uses the existing shared tooltip implementation. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 2 items remain** Keep open: this maintainer-authored PR addresses a visible navigation problem that remains on current main. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `ef7658d1f7693556257ede00e4e6df9989ebb5a8` ## Before merge - [ ] **Control the viewport assumption in both inherited-placement tests (P2)** - Both new test groups assume an unspecified placement resolves to right, but TooltipOwner intentionally returns bottom-start when the narrow-screen media query matches. Exact-head WebKit CI fails here and at line 678 with that result. Explicitly establish a desktop media-query condition for these inheritance assertions and restore it afterward, following the existing scoped matchMedia setup; preserve the production mobile fallback. - [ ] **Complete next step** - Have the CI owner inspect and attribute the separate check-test-types-core-1 failure before merge; its diagnostic log was unavailable through the allowed network. ## Findings - [P2] Control the viewport assumption in both inherited-placement tests — `ui/src/components/tooltip.test.ts:129`
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Control UI feeds wrapped controls and adapted title hints through TooltipOwner, which selects placement for the shared native overlay renderer. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Sidebar rail] --> B[Wrapped controls] A --> C[Adapted title hints] B --> D[TooltipOwner] C --> D D --> E[Placement and mobile fallback] E --> F[Native tooltip overlay] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep placement resolution in TooltipOwner and make both new test groups explicitly control their viewport assumptions. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source establishes the top-placement path, and the supplied before screenshot shows its visible effect; no target code was executed during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The shared-owner inheritance is a small, coherent fix covering both title-adapted and wrapped rail controls while preserving explicit placement and responsive behavior. Full review comments: - [P2] Control the viewport assumption in both inherited-placement tests — `ui/src/components/tooltip.test.ts:129` Both new test groups assume an unspecified placement resolves to right, but TooltipOwner intentionally returns bottom-start when the narrow-screen media query matches. Exact-head WebKit CI fails here and at line 678 with that result. Explicitly establish a desktop media-query condition for these inheritance assertions and restore it afterward, following the existing scoped matchMedia setup; preserve the production mobile fallback. Confidence: 1 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.98 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [d97b12486899](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d97b12486899e964e39593db8055682010f5bd83). ### Provenance checked - `Shared tooltip placement defaults` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (b68c44ca8f3ca9d0d4bccb7b620f867547e4cd55: The native-overlay migration preserved callers and appearance, including the generic top default; the PR explains its narrow rail-specific exception.) - `Narrow-screen side-placement fallback` keeps the original intent (b9050029efe97266108667536e25b1a806e6dafd: Side cards cannot fit beside menus on narrow viewports, so they fall back below the anchor; history across TooltipController and TooltipOwner confirms this policy was retained.) - `Existing browser hover assertions` keeps the original intent (ed50f59ccebc43716bc5954ecafe63fc8f002caa: Chat-action work established shared tooltip interaction coverage; this PR extends the existing rail checks with placement geometry.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - OPENCLAW_UI_WEBKIT=1 pnpm --dir ui test src/components/tooltip.test.ts - pnpm check:changed What I checked: - **Introduced change:** The pinned diff places the rail declaration and inherited-placement decision in existing owners, without adding a parallel renderer or state store. ([`ui/src/components/tooltip-owner.ts:135`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ef7658d1f7693556257ede00e4e6df9989ebb5a8/ui/src/components/tooltip-owner.ts#L135), [ef7658d1f769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ef7658d1f7693556257ede00e4e6df9989ebb5a8)) - **Current main remains affected:** Current main defaults unspecified placement to top and has no rail placement declaration. ([`ui/src/components/tooltip-owner.ts:135`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d97b12486899e964e39593db8055682010f5bd83/ui/src/components/tooltip-owner.ts#L135), [d97b12486899](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d97b12486899e964e39593db8055682010f5bd83)) - **Inspected visual proof:** Both downloaded PR screenshots were inspected: the before image shows Pages above the rail button; the after image shows it centered to the right in the same synthetic Control UI fixture. ([ef7658d1f769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ef7658d1f7693556257ede00e4e6df9989ebb5a8)) - **Diff-caused WebKit failures:** Exact-head CI reports two new tooltip assertions failing with expected right, received bottom-start: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39374012044/job/118468382286. ([`ui/src/components/tooltip.test.ts:129`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ef7658d1f7693556257ede00e4e6df9989ebb5a8/ui/src/components/tooltip.test.ts#L129), [ef7658d1f769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ef7658d1f7693556257ede00e4e6df9989ebb5a8)) - **Preserved responsive contract:** The historical environment-picker change deliberately sends right-side cards below their anchor on narrow viewports; this PR retains that policy. ([`ui/src/components/tooltip.ts:652`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b9050029efe97266108667536e25b1a806e6dafd/ui/src/components/tooltip.ts#L652), [b9050029efe9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b9050029efe97266108667536e25b1a806e6dafd)) - **Unattributed core CI failure:** The core test-types stripe failed, but its annotation contains only exit code 2; job-log retrieval was blocked at the Azure storage redirect, so its cause remains unverified: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39374012044/job/118468925714.
